ingredients.name: And sliced waxy potatoes
ingredients.originalText: 11 ounces peeled and sliced waxy potatoes

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter; 2 large leeks; 1 quart chicken or veggie stock; 11 ounces peeled and sliced waxy potatoes; 1 bay leaf; ¾ cup heavy cream; white pepper; (optional) ½ teaspoon ground nutmeg; (optional) ½ tablespoon dill weed. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: And sliced waxy potatoes: peeled. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
Chop the white to light-green part of the leek into moderately sized pieces and discard the dark-green ends.
Melt the butter in a pot on medium-low heat, add chopped leeks and potatoes.
Add stock, bay leaf, pepper and optional ingredients now.
Raise heat to medium-high, simmer until potatoes are tender. A simmer means small, gentle bubbles; lower the burner if it boils vigorously.
After removing the pot from the heat, remove the bay leaf and immersion blend pot until you reach a desired consistency.
Stir in heavy cream and salt to taste.

Before serving, insert a food thermometer into the thickest piece of chicken or turkey, away from bone: it must reach 165°F (74°C). If using already-cooked poultry, reheat it to 165°F (74°C). Continue cooking and recheck if needed; wash hands and utensils after handling raw poultry and do not rinse it.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.
